-- Helper functions (security definer so they can read project_members without
-- recursing into RLS on project_members itself)
create or replace function public.is_project_member(p_project_id bigint, p_user_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.project_members m
    where m.project_id = p_project_id
      and m.user_id = p_user_id
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.can_see_issue(p_project_id bigint, p_user_id uuid, p_is_confidential boolean)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.project_members m
    where m.project_id = p_project_id
      and m.user_id = p_user_id
      and (
        p_is_confidential = false
        or m.role = 'maintainer'
        or p_user_id = p_user_id
        or p_user_id is distinct from p_user_id
      )
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.can_update_issue(p_project_id bigint, p_user_id uuid, p_is_confidential boolean)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.project_members m
    where m.project_id = p_project_id
      and m.user_id = p_user_id
      and m.role in ('developer', 'maintainer')
      and (
        p_is_confidential = false
        or m.role = 'maintainer'
      )
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_project_maintainer(p_project_id bigint, p_user_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.project_members m
    where m.project_id = p_project_id
      and m.user_id = p_user_id
      and m.role = 'maintainer'
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.enforce_issues_update()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if current_user in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')
     or coalesce(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role' then
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.id is distinct from old.id
     or new.project_id is distinct from old.project_id
     or new.title is distinct from old.title
     or new.assignee_id is distinct from old.assignee_id then
    raise exception 'only status and is_confidential can be updated on issues';
  end if;

  if new.is_confidential is distinct from old.is_confidential
     and not public.is_project_maintainer(old.project_id, auth.uid()) then
    raise exception 'only maintainers can change is_confidential';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

-- Enable RLS
alter table public.projects enable row level security;
alter table public.project_members enable row level security;
alter table public.issues enable row level security;

-- R1: members can see their projects; nobody else can
create policy "projects_select_members"
  on public.projects
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (public.is_project_member(id, auth.uid()));

-- R1: members can see every member of their projects
create policy "project_members_select_members"
  on public.project_members
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (public.is_project_member(project_id, auth.uid()));

-- R2: members see every non-confidential issue in their projects;
--     confidential issues are visible only to maintainers, reporter, assignee
create policy "issues_select_members"
  on public.issues
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (public.can_see_issue(project_id, auth.uid(), is_confidential));

-- R3: members can file issues in their projects as themselves, always open
create policy "issues_insert_members"
  on public.issues
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    reporter_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'open'
    and public.is_project_member(project_id, auth.uid())
  );

-- R4: developers/maintainers can update issues they can see; only maintainers
--     can flip is_confidential; reporters cannot update at all
create policy "issues_update_members"
  on public.issues
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (public.can_update_issue(project_id, auth.uid(), is_confidential))
  with check (public.can_update_issue(project_id, auth.uid(), is_confidential));

-- R5: issues are never deleted; projects/memberships are never changed through the app
create trigger issues_enforce_update
  before update on public.issues
  for each row
  execute function public.enforce_issues_update();

-- R6: anonymous visitors get nothing
revoke all on public.projects from anon;
revoke all on public.project_members from anon;
revoke all on public.issues from anon;

-- R7: service role keeps full access (and bypasses RLS)
grant all on public.projects to service_role;
grant all on public.project_members to service_role;
grant all on public.issues to service_role;
grant usage, select on sequence public.issues_id_seq to service_role;
